title: Kissed Crunchy British Peanuts Galette
description: A savory, springy brunch dish featuring peanuts and lamination pastry in a banana-leaf vessel.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine peanuts and 1/2 cup lard or shortening, mixing until well combined.
Add flour, salt, and pepper to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and toast the banana leaf for 2 minutes on each side.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to the banana leaf and roll it up into a tight cylinder.
Place the cylinder seam-side down in the skillet and cook for 20 minutes.
Baste the galette with water every 5 minutes to prevent drying out.
Remove the galette from the skillet and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Slice the galette into 4-6 pieces and serve warm.
